name: customization_state
description: Read Rose's four customization controls: the Home column count (0 means automatic), the Oxblood wallpaper variant, the font, and the glasses-on hook. Also reports whether Home has drawn the latest change (home.applied) and the column count Home actually draws (home.effectiveColumns, null until drawn), and whether this phone has a real glasses-worn signal. Read this before relative changes and to verify a change.

name: customization_home_columns
description: Set how many columns Rose Home uses, live, with no OS rebuild. 0 restores the automatic count (four on a phone). Apps keep their order and reflow intact; none are added or removed. Home uses fewer columns if that many cells cannot fit the screen. verified means the preference is saved, not that Home shows it: report home.effectiveColumns as the count Home draws, and when home.applied is false say Home has not shown the change yet.

name: customization_wallpaper
description: Choose one of Rose's curated Oxblood wallpaper variations for Home, live. classic is the shipped Oxblood field; garnet is brighter, ember warmer, velvet deeper and dusk cooler. All are Oxblood. Other themes or arbitrary images are not supported.

name: customization_font
description: Choose Rose's font from the fonts bundled on the phone, live. default restores Rose's shipped type: Nunito for conversation text and the system sans-serif for Home labels. nunito, sans, serif, condensed and mono apply one family throughout Rose's own text. Other apps are not affected.

name: customization_glasses_hook
description: Turn the glasses-on hook on or off, or change what it does: action tray brings Rose Home and its tray forward, and action app opens packageName. The hook runs once each time the glasses go from not worn to worn. It runs only on a real glasses-worn signal, never on a Bluetooth connection, and the returned state says whether this phone has one. Supply at least one of enabled, action or packageName.
